718:t_1:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「So you've confined $$サクリファイ$$ in the dimensional prison.」

718:t_1:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「It's boring... The four of us finally got together for the first time in 12,000 years, too...」

718:t_1:7.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「But that is the only way to punish her.」

718:t_1:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Exactly. We abandoned all conflict 120 million years ago and were reborn as the four $$御使い$$s.」

718:t_1:9.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The days when we were inferior life-forms who hurt and killed one another are long past...」

718:t_1:10.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「That is why, on that day 12,000 years ago, we sought to resolve the situation by parting ways.」

718:t_1:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I accept that, too.」

718:t_1:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is precisely why I returned to you with $$ヘリオース$$ before the universe's great collapse, which occurs once every 120 million years.」

718:t_1:13.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「What are you going to do about those inferior creatures entering the $$カオス・コスモス$$ and even showing signs of $$シンカ$$?」

718:t_1:14.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$テンプティ$$... What do you want to do?」

718:t_1:15.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「As long as it's fun, I don't mind. We can let those kids roam free, or squish them flat.」

718:t_1:16.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「What do you want, $$ドクトリン$$?」

718:t_1:17.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We cannot permit them to exist.」

718:t_1:18.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then with two votes for annihilation, one to defer, and one abstention, let us annihilate them.」

718:t_1:19.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Are you sure, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$? You were fond of those kids, weren't you?」

718:t_1:20.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I am an $$御使い$$. I have no intention of letting personal feelings interfere with my mission.」

718:t_1:21.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Though we cannot call our emotions individual possessions.」

718:t_1:22.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The Earthlings from that world are not the only foreign bodies that have entered the $$カオス・コスモス$$.」

718:t_1:23.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「The evil gods, right? Those guys... really are a calamity for the universe.」

718:t_1:24.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Depending on the circumstances, we may have to deal with them, too.」

718:t_1:25.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But first, we will annihilate the Earthlings. They are drawing close to the dimensional prison.」

718:t_1:26.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You mean $$サクリファイ$$ broke through the barrier and called those kids...?!」

718:t_1:27.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「$$ハマリエル$$ is among them. Her $$悲しみの乙女$$ probably resonated with $$サクリファイ$$'s sorrow.」

718:t_1:28.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「We could call this an opportunity guided by the $$黒い太陽#sol$$. If we annihilate the Earthlings before her eyes, she will change her mind.」

718:t_1:29.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Indeed. If she remembers her role as an $$御使い$$, we can unite under our mission again.」

718:t_1:30.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Then let $$テンプティ$$ handle the Earthlings. $$ドクトリン$$ has to adjust $$プロディキウム$$, and you need $$ヘリオース$$ for that, right?」

718:t_1:31.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Very well, $$テンプティ$$. Go and enjoy yourself to your heart's content.」

718:t_1:32.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Just thinking about it gets me excited! I wonder how much those kids will resist!」

718:t_2:5.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「My name is $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$... I am one of those who call themselves the $$御使い$$s.」

718:t_2:6.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$ハマリエル・ザ・スター$$... Thank you for answering my call.」

718:t_2:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「My name is $$セツコ・オハラ$$. Please call me $$セツコ$$.」

718:t_2:8.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I cannot do that.」

718:t_2:10.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「You are a $$スフィア・リアクター$$... That means you walk a predetermined destiny.」

718:t_2:11.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「We name the Reactors according to that path.」

718:t_2:13.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「The Star in your name means a star shining in the heavens... Your destiny is to lose those close and dear to you, and shine only in solitude...」

718:t_2:14.en:
$$ランド$$
「What the hell is that supposed to mean...?!」

718:t_2:15.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$ウェルキエル・ザ・ヒート$$... You are steel being forged...」

718:t_2:16.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「By enduring hardship, you take on heat, and that becomes strength.」

718:t_2:17.en:
$$メール$$
「It's the same as Darling's nickname...!」

718:t_2:18.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「I don't think that's a coincidence.」

718:t_2:20.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$ズリエル・ジ・アンブレイカブル$$... You are...」

718:t_2:21.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Stop. I have no interest in astrology.」

718:t_2:22.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「To you, the future... in other words, fate, may seem uncertain. But it is decided in advance.」

718:t_2:23.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I engraved the $$烙印$$ on you to set it in motion.」

718:t_2:25.en:
$$シャア$$
「The way you speak... Do you mean that was your own act, rather than the $$御使い$$s'?」

718:t_2:27.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Before I explain what that act meant, let me tell you about our existence... about the $$御使い$$s.」

718:t_2:28.en:
$n
「At last... Has the time come to learn what they really are...?」

718:t_2:29.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「We are the first species in all the universes to touch $$オリジン・ロー$$ and the truth, and attain $$シンカ$$ as higher-dimensional life-forms.」

718:t_2:30.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「That was 120 million years ago.」

718:t_2:31.en:
$$タケル$$
(So even the $$御使い$$s use Earth's units...)

718:t_2:32.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Then we imposed a duty on ourselves: to guide species that would eventually awaken as higher-dimensional life-forms.」

718:t_2:33.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So that's the mission of higher-dimensional life-forms...」

718:t_2:34.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Exactly. It is all to fill this universe with the truth.」

718:t_2:35.en:
$$キラ$$
「Is that why you monitored various planets, including Earth?」

718:t_2:36.en:
$$シン$$
「What truth...?! What you're doing is domination!」

718:t_2:37.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「We had no choice...」

718:t_2:38.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Contrary to our wishes, not many species awakened to the truth.」

718:t_2:39.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「In fact, some underwent distorted evolution and spread conflict throughout this universe.」

718:t_2:41.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「That was the most efficient way to guide species toward $$シンカ$$.」

718:t_2:42.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see... And you classified those who evolved contrary to your wishes as enemies.」

718:t_2:43.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Is that why you decided the $$インベーダー#robot$$s were $$バアル$$?」

718:t_2:44.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「That is the mission of those who have awakened as higher-dimensional life-forms.」

718:t_2:45.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「We guided all the universes in accordance with it.」

718:t_2:46.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「The universe is reborn in a collapse once every 12,000 years, and new species are born each time... We guide them into the next 12,000 years...」

718:t_2:47.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Various life-forms are born in various universes. They evolve in various ways and each tries to overcome the collapse of the universe...」

718:t_2:48.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Through that repetition, the universe's cycle of rebirth continued.」

718:t_2:49.en:
$$葵$$
「You sound like you're playing producer of the universe.」

718:t_2:50.en:
$$勝平$$
「Does being the first to attain $$シンカ$$ give you the right to destroy a whole galaxy?!」

718:t_2:51.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「...That is a fair criticism...」
